column1: # THE GOOSE WIRE-FUZZ ARMS THAT ANNOUNCE NO ROOTS (make/goose-wirefuzz.sh).
# One row per unit and arm whose driver answers "the leg has a codec for none
# of the N roots the corpus names" today: the unit, the arm (builder, fixed or
# retain) and one line saying why. The builder and retain arms read the
# variable-class file roots and the fixed arm the value-only roots; each row
# records what the driver announced when it was measured. An arm that announces no
# roots and is not carried here fails the gate, and so does a row whose arm
# runs or whose unit is gone: a driver that stops presenting a unit's roots
# reads red, never as one arm fewer. Measured 2026-11-21 on amd-2 with
